one_liner: Snowflake is a cloud data warehouse offering REST and Python APIs to execute SQL queries, manage deployments, and perform data operations.

auth.notes: Supports OAuth, key-pair authentication (JWT), and workload identity federation. All credentials transmitted as Bearer tokens in Authorization headers.

access.notes: Pages mention trial accounts but do not specify self-serve access model, approval requirements, or whether a free tier exists. OAuth integration setup requires ACCOUNTADMIN role in existing Snowflake account.

evidence.snippet: You need the ACCOUNTADMIN role, or a role with the privilege to create integrations.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: API enforces rate limits; clients must reduce request frequency and retry with backoff. Specific limit thresholds not documented.

evidence.snippet: The Snowflake SQL API is a REST API that you can use to access and update data in a Snowflake database.
You can use this API to execute standard queries and most DDL and DML statements.
Too many requests. The number of requests hit the rate limit. The application must reduce the frequency of requests

buildability.rationale: Public REST API and SDKs are documented and functional; OAuth is self-serve but users must set up their own OAuth app (not Composio-managed) and require ACCOUNTADMIN role.
